Container.Name: FlessingLabs-QuickShop
Container.Overview:
Item catalogue for the Yuvomi shopping list: create items once, put them on the list with one tap.
This container stores the catalogue and is the new entrance to Yuvomi: open Yuvomi through this container's port from now on. Everything that is not QuickShop is passed to Yuvomi unchanged. Yuvomi itself keeps running as before.
Also install the QuickShop module into Yuvomi (Settings - Modules, or copy the module folder into Yuvomi's modules path). Guide: https://github.com/FlessingLabs/yuvomi-quickshop

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to open Yuvomi WITH QuickShop. Use this instead of Yuvomi's own port.

Config.Name: Yuvomi URL
Config.Description: Address of your Yuvomi container as seen from here: your Unraid IP and Yuvomi's port, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:3000.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Catalogue database (quickshop.db). Include it in your backups.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_ORIGIN
Config.Description: Optional. Fixed public address(es), comma-separated, e.g. https://yuvomi.example.org. Empty = the address the browser used.
